version.changelog:
- Added new tag: reuse (for flagging duplicated helpers/utils within the repo).
- Updated examples and tags section in SKILL.md to document the new reuse tag and provide relevant examples.
- Removed the file: skill-card.md.

llm.summary: This skill is a narrow code-review helper that only instructs the agent to identify over-engineering in diffs.

dimensions.detail: The requested behavior only needs access to the diff being reviewed and is proportionate to the skill purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill file with no executable scripts, dependencies, install hooks, or bundled payloads observed.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are limited to output format, review tags, examples, scoring, and boundaries; they do not request system override, hidden behavior, credential access, network use, or tool execution.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background execution, memory writing, or long-running worker behavior is present.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose and instructions match: it reviews diffs for unnecessary complexity and suggests deletions or simpler replacements.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Installers should expect this skill to produce terse, deletion-focused review comments about complexity only; correctness, security, and performance review are explicitly out of scope and should be handled separately.
